snippet.title: DEATH STRANDING 2: ON THE BEACH - Game Premiere - Orpheum Theatre - June 8, 2025
snippet.description:
On June 8th, 2025, live inside The Orpheum Theatre in Los Angeles, California for the DEATH STRANDING 2: ON THE BEACH Game Premiere hosted by Geoff Keighley!

Presented by KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS, this exclusive event features a live demonstration of the DEATH STRANDING 2: ON THE BEACH, a panel with special guests, and an inside look at the creative process from the legendary mind behind it all - Hideo Kojima himself.

#deathstranding2 #ps5games
